name: Suspension Chest Fly
steps: Face away from a suspension trainer anchor, grasp both handles with palms inward, and lean forward into a straight plank stance.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly while keeping a slight, constant soft bend in your elbows.
Open both arms smoothly out to the sides to lower your chest forward until you feel a controlled pectoral stretch.
Squeeze your chest strongly to sweep both handles back together in front of your shoulders.
tips: Step forward or backward to adjust your body angle so you control the stretched bottom position safely.
Hold a fixed slight bend in your elbows without bending deeply into a push-up.
